plan.description: D77-TC Pelican from Halo: olive drab UNSC angular military dropship, large squared cockpit nose, two short forward wings, four rotating engine nacelles, rear troop cargo hull, orange engine glow. Side three-quarter profile facing right.
plan.sourceReference: Le Pelican transporte les forces UNSC et possede un armement de bord ; renfort ponctuel adapte au RPG.

plan.description: Dog from Half-Life 2: Alyx’s large friendly improvised robot, orange-rust industrial panels, round white single optical eye, enormous articulated long arms with clamp hands, squat bent legs, exposed cables; recognizable HL2 Dog, not a dog animal.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability alyx_vance: Dog Breach Assist

plan.description: Aperture Science turret from Portal: iconic white smooth teardrop upright robot shell, black central vertical seam with single red optical eye, three thin black tripod legs, two white gun pods opening horizontally; no human operator.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability chell: Turret Summon

plan.description: PAYDAY 2 portable sentry gun: squat black tactical automatic gun on sturdy three-legged folding tripod, short exposed barrel, square ammunition box, motorized upper housing and blue status diode, pointing right. No human.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability dallas: Sentry Deploy

plan.description: Slender: The Eight Pages page deployment: a cluster of three aged off-white handwritten forest warning pages pinned to a small branch frame, recognizable pencil-tree scratches and circle-cross mark as abstract marks only. No readable letters, no magical creature or new weapon.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability survivor: Page Trap

plan.description: DOOM Eternal BFG-9000: iconic very large olive-black science-fiction cannon, thick broad angular housing, luminous neon-green plasma chamber, front multi-part circular barrel, industrial grips and cables; equipment alone, facing right, not a generic rifle.
plan.sourceReference: Arme canonique, pas une creature invoquee : presentation RPG d un tir et de ses arcs d energie.

plan.description: Great Yamada Attack from Guilty Gear Xrd: May’s enormous friendly stylized blue whale Yamada, broad rounded blue body, pale belly, small black eye, rounded fins, jaunty happy expression, crest of ocean spray; full whale, no May character.
plan.sourceReference: Yamada est la baleine presente dans cet Overdrive ; timings et impact unique adaptes.

plan.description: Ifrit from original Final Fantasy VII 1997: muscular bestial fire summon with reddish-brown fur and skin, huge curled pale horns, dark wild mane, clawed hands and feet, heavy beast muzzle, glowing amber eyes, flame at feet and raised claws. Original FFVII creature identity, not humanoid armored remake design.
plan.sourceReference: Ifrit summon materia: Hellfire

plan.description: Shiva from original Final Fantasy VII 1997: regal adult ice summon with pale blue skin, long blue hair swept upward/back, violet eyes, purple-blue ornate modest full-coverage bodice and long translucent ice-blue skirt/sash, delicate icy jewelry, bare hands shaping an ice crystal; elegant upright ice queen, nonsexual portrayal.
plan.sourceReference: Shiva summon materia: Diamond Dust

plan.description: Bahamut from original Final Fantasy VII 1997: large purple-blue plated dragon, broad outstretched bat-like wings with violet membranes, long tail, two swept horns, horned angular head, powerful clawed legs, luminous golden eyes, cosmic blue energy gathered in mouth. Entire wing silhouette safely inside frame.
plan.sourceReference: Bahamut summon materia: Megaflare

plan.key: Sonic::Tails et le Tornado::Tornado Machine Gun
plan.description: Tails and the Tornado from Sonic: iconic red propeller biplane with yellow-orange details, two stacked red wings and white wing struts, small yellow twin-tailed fox Tails with white muzzle and pilot goggles in open cockpit; plane facing right. Keep distinctive Sonic-era cartoon proportions.
plan.sourceReference: Tails pilote le Tornado equipe de mitrailleuses ; appel en soutien adapte au RPG.

plan.description: Star Platinum from JoJo Part 3 Stardust Crusaders: very muscular purple humanoid Stand, long flowing dark-purple hair, golden headband, teal eyes, purple skin, golden shoulder guards and gloves, white short scarf and dark loincloth, tall confident fighting stance, fists raised. No Jotaro.
plan.sourceReference: Manifestation du Stand Star Platinum et barrage de poings ; cadence et degats adaptes.

plan.key: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure::Hermit Purple::Hermit Purple — Hamon
plan.description: Hermit Purple from JoJo Part 3 Stardust Crusaders: a distinct animated coil of thorny purple-magenta vines emerging in a loop, angular thorns and small sparks of yellow Hamon electricity; no humanoid Stand, no Joseph, no generic tentacles.
plan.sourceReference: Hermit Purple est le Stand de Joseph age ; ses lianes peuvent conduire le Hamon.

plan.description: Gold Experience from JoJo Part 5 Golden Wind: slim athletic gold humanoid Stand, smooth insect-like golden armor with stylized shell/wing forms, purple circular ladybug emblems on chest, purple eyes and accents, gloved hands extended to create small green leaves; no Giorno.
plan.sourceReference: Manifestation du Stand Gold Experience ; seule sa frappe est transposee ici.

plan.description: Soulèvement Ghostline from original Neon Requiem: small coordinated crew of three adult memory-liberation resistance operatives, dark city coats with cyan Ghostline circuit strips, visor goggles, one transparent cyan memory-key tablet, one signal antenna, one defensive raised hand; distinct figures in compact formation.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability imani_quell: Soulèvement Ghostline

plan.key: The Aether Crown::Mutinerie des Cieux::Mutinerie des Cieux
plan.description: Mutinerie des Cieux from original The Aether Crown: a compact original steampunk skyship mutineer boarding crew of three adults, navy and copper flightcoats, goggles, ropes and boarding hooks, teal aether lantern, wind-swept coat hems, no real-world insignia.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability elara_voss: Mutinerie des Cieux

plan.description: Drone Soupape from original The Aether Crown: a small spherical brass-and-navy steampunk pressure-release drone, visible rivets, round pressure gauge, two copper valve wheels, small propeller and paired steam exhaust pipes, teal aether engine. No generic sci-fi sphere.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability bram_quill: Drone Soupape

plan.key: Meridian Clockwork::Faucon à Ressort::Faucon à Ressort
plan.description: Faucon à Ressort from original Meridian Clockwork: elegant brass mechanical falcon, layered articulated copper feathers, blue enamel eyes, exposed coiled mainspring chest, tiny clockwork gears, wings unfurling into attack; unmistakable bird silhouette.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability lio_ferrante: Faucon à Ressort

plan.key: Aegea: War of the Moirai::Forge des Cent Boucliers::Forge des Cent Boucliers
plan.description: Forge des Cent Boucliers from original Aegea War of the Moirai: bronze phalanx shield deployment, compact formation of three overlapping round hammered bronze hoplite shields with turquoise geometric forge inlay and supporting iron braces; a glowing small central anvil spark, no human faces or arbitrary magic circle.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability doros_bronzehand: Forge des Cent Boucliers

plan.key: Tawantinsuyu: The Split Sun::Message des Quatre Quartiers::Message des Quatre Quartiers
plan.description: Message des Quatre Quartiers from original Tawantinsuyu The Split Sun: four adult Andean chasqui messenger silhouettes in ochre/red/teal woven tunics, quipu cords and feathered relay standards, compact coordinated relay formation, stylized historical Andean design rooted in the fictional world.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability killa_mayu: Message des Quatre Quartiers

plan.key: Yomi no Kage::Parade Nocturne Réconciliée::Parade Nocturne Réconciliée
plan.description: Parade Nocturne Réconciliée from original Yomi no Kage: compact procession of distinct friendly reconciled yokai spirits, a broad red oni with short horns and patterned indigo coat, a paper lantern tsukumogami with one eye, and a small fox spirit, warm lantern light, no horror gore.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability daichi_kurogane: Parade Nocturne Réconciliée

plan.key: Mandate of Nine Heavens::Pas de l’Ancêtre::Pas de l’Ancêtre
plan.description: Pas de l’Ancêtre from original Mandate of Nine Heavens: dignified translucent ancestral martial spirit, adult Chinese elder in ivory-and-maroon layered robes, swept tied white hair, simple bronze ritual bell sword held low, pale gold cloud wisps at feet, calm protective stance; no deity from an unrelated franchise.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability mei_zhen: Pas de l’Ancêtre

plan.key: Ilyr Concordat::Chœur Nym Non Unanime::Chœur Nym Non Unanime
plan.description: Chœur Nym Non Unanime from original Ilyr Concordat: an original swarm-choir of nine small violet crystalline biomechanical nodes, each node a distinct angular dark-purple carapace with bright magenta core, linked by thin branching violet light filaments, asymmetric plurality rather than one giant orb.
plan.sourceReference: Existing project ability ixo_9: Chœur Nym Non Unanime

plan.description: Black Egrets Inferno Brigade from Skullgirls 2nd Encore: three distinct royal military soldiers in stylized dark black uniforms, tall dark helmets with rounded face-obscuring gas masks, red armbands, white accents, small firearms held in coordinated formation; Skullgirls cartoon proportions, no real-world extremist insignia.
plan.sourceReference: Les Black Egrets sont les soldats appeles dans le Blockbuster ; la presentation RPG est adaptee.
